description: Retrieves a single Gmail draft by its ID. Use this to fetch and inspect draft content before sending via GMAIL_SEND_DRAFT. The format parameter controls the level of detail returned.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format for the draft message: 'minimal' (ID/labels only), 'full' (complete data with parsed payload), 'raw' (base64url-encoded RFC 2822 format), 'metadata' (ID/labels/headers only).

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

draft_id.title: Draft Id
draft_id.description: The ID of the draft to retrieve. Draft IDs are typically alphanumeric strings (e.g., 'r99885592323229922'). Use GMAIL_LIST_DRAFTS to retrieve valid draft IDs.

DraftMessage.title: DraftMessage

to.title: To
to.description: The recipient (To header) of the draft message

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: The entire email message in RFC 2822 format, base64url-encoded (only present when format=raw)

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: The sender (From header) of the draft message

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The MIME payload structure of the draft message

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: A preview of the draft message with subject and body snippet

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject line of the draft message

labelIds.title: Label Ids
labelIds.description: The label IDs applied to the draft message

threadId.title: Thread Id
threadId.description: The thread ID of the draft message

messageId.title: Message Id
messageId.description: The message ID of the draft message

messageText.title: Message Text
messageText.description: The full text content of the draft message

attachmentList.title: Attachment List
attachmentList.description: The list of attachments in the draft message

messageTimestamp.title: Message Timestamp
messageTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the draft message in ISO-8601 format

DraftMessage.description: The message content of the draft

id.title: Id
id.description: The immutable ID of the draft

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: Web UI link to view this draft in Gmail

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
